Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

tobit.mean 0.1.0.9000

  • mean_tobit(), geomean_tobit(), and sd_tobit() results have a "status" attribute saying how the result was reached, one of the codes in the new exported tobit_status_codes (for example "converged", "not_converged", "all_below_lower"). The "message" attribute is unchanged.
  • as_mean_tobit(), as_geomean_tobit(), and as_sd_tobit() take a status argument (NULL by default, giving no attribute, as before).
  • Every error and warning has a class, listed in the new exported tobit_condition_classes (tobit_mean_error_<what> or tobit_mean_warning_<what>, with the parent class tobit_mean_error or tobit_mean_warning), so it can be handled without matching its message. The classes are added in front of those stop() and warning() gave (simpleError or simpleWarning, then error or warning, and condition), so code that tests for those keeps working; a printed condition now begins with its new class name. The messages are unchanged.

tobit.mean 0.1.0

  • Initial CRAN submission.
